summary: RFCs 4328 and 7139 give RSVP-TE signaling extensions for controlling Optical Transport Network features, but they do not cover the additional ODU containers defined in G.Sup43. This informational document adds the signaling needed for those extra signal types.

eli5.summary: Optical networks carry data in standard-sized containers. A few newer container sizes were missing from the setup instructions, so this adds them.
